pages.text: Build a $(bold)Crushing Wheel$() pair and one ore comes out as two ingots. That is the first payoff of $(t1)Tier 1$() engineering, and it is all $(bold)Create$().$(br2)Set up rotational power (a water wheel or hand crank), build a Mechanical Press for plates, then the Crushing Wheel pair for the 2x step.

pages.title: Banking T1 Tokens
pages.text: Brass is the Tier 1 ceiling material and a bread-and-butter submission. Machine blocks mint the most: a $(bold)Crushing Wheel$() banks $(t1)25$() tokens and a $(bold)Mechanical Press$() $(t1)20$() (capped at 2 each).$(br2)Bank $(t1){{tier 1 threshold}}$() in total to ascend to $(t2)Tier 2$(). The full Create writeup is in $(l:icraft:mods_t1/create)Create$(/l).
